title: Agility Robotics and Churchill Capital Corp XI S-4 Registration Statement Declared Effective by SEC in Connection with Proposed Business Combination
source_used: Agility Robotics release on Business Wire, read on FinancialContent
key_facts: Agility Robotics said the SEC declared effective on 13 Oct 2026 its joint Form S-4 registration statement with Churchill Capital Corp XI (Nasdaq: CCXI) for their proposed business combination.
Churchill XI has set an extraordinary general meeting for 2 Nov 2026 so its shareholders can vote on the deal; closing is expected in November 2026.
Expected gross proceeds are more than $620 million: about $424 million in Churchill XI's trust account (assuming no redemptions) and about $200 million from a common stock PIPE led by Foxconn.
Proceeds are meant to fill existing customer orders, expand deployments and scale production of Digit 5.
Agility says the combined company would be the only US publicly listed pure-play humanoid robotics company with proven, active commercial deployments, trading on Nasdaq as AGLT.

Agility cites customers including Schaeffler, GXO and Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada and more than 65,000 hours of real-world operation by earlier Digit generations; its RoboFab plant is designed to build up to 10,000 robots a year.
The deal remains subject to Churchill XI shareholder approval and other customary closing conditions.
quote_evidence: Churchill XI has set a shareholder meeting date of November 2, 2026 to approve the proposed business combination and related matters.

The proposed business combination is expected to provide more than $620 million in gross proceeds, including approximately $424 million of cash held in Churchill XI's trust account (assuming no redemptions by Churchill XI shareholders) and approximately $200 million of incremental capital through a common stock PIPE led by Foxconn, with participation from leading existing and new institutional investors.
Upon closing, the combined company is expected to be the only U.S. publicly listed pure-play humanoid robotics company with proven, active commercial deployments.
why_it_matters_hint: A vote on 2 Nov 2026 could give investors their first listed pure-play humanoid robot maker, by the company's own description.
event_date: SEC declared the registration statement effective on 13 Oct 2026.
notes: Company press release (Business Wire text carried by FinancialContent); business claims are Agility's own. The milestone bullet list of the release was not in the saved text.
